verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks for GrowthBook events. The nearest items are adjacent features that do not qualify: Proxy streaming pushes real-time updates to JavaScript/React SDKs, the tracking plugin forwards 'Experiment Viewed' events to Google Analytics and Segment, and the REST API is pull-based. The axis applies to a feature-flag/experimentation SaaS, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
